svg.title: Lockstep
svg.desc: Lockstep: a batch-invariant inference engine and the harness that tries to prove it wrong. Two traces of one workload run coincident and then fork at 44 co-resident byte-identical requests, where logprobs disagree, which became vllm-project/vllm issue 51187. 65 of 65 relation runs bitwise, 10 of 10 seeded faults killed, 19 of 25 lifecycle 2-grams reached, one finding filed upstream.
